# Test that parse errors are handled gracefully with informative comments
env INPUT_DIR=$HOME/.appledocs/cache/developer.apple.com/tutorials/data/documentation

# Parse a file that will cause a parse error (enum type)
exec occ2go $INPUT_DIR/CoreGraphics/CGBitmapInfo.json

# Verify it outputs a parse error comment instead of exiting
stdout 'Parse error'
stdout 'unsupported symbol type'
stdout 'Symbol: CGBitmapInfo'
stdout 'Component information for a bitmap image'

# Verify it doesn't exit with error status (graceful handling)
